description: This file provides helper methods for performing share account transactions within integration tests, including creating, retrieving, updating, and posting commands to share accounts via RESTful API calls.

classes.name: ShareAccountTransactionHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing share account transactions in integration tests.

methods.name: createShareAccount
methods.description: Creates a new share account using a JSON payload and returns the resource ID.

methods.name: retrieveShareAccount
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific share account by its ID.

methods.name: updateShareAccount
methods.description: Updates an existing share account with new data provided in JSON format.

methods.name: postCommand
methods.description: Posts a command to a specific share account, potentially performing actions like approval or disbursement.
